strategy.statement: Use the 157 direct GSE75010 BioBank samples as one cohort and the seven historical source cohorts separately. Never add the 330-sample composite as another independent cohort.

GSE234729_ANALYTIC_123.reason: All 123 normalized-expression columns are recoverable, including 12 GSE186257 reanalyses, but public sample-level gestational-age and sequencing-batch crosswalks are not recoverable. Use published adjusted evidence or a recovered crosswalk; do not fit an unadjusted primary disease model.

GSE75010_BIOBANK.reason: Exclude chronic-hypertension strata from the primary contrast; retain 63 non-CH PE and 53 non-CH normotensive controls. Model gestational age and prespecified clinical fields; keep CH samples in the exclusion log and sensitivity inventory.

GSE30186.reason: Independent Chinese placental cohort; sample-level gestational age is unavailable and must be treated as a risk, not imputed.
GSE30186.expression_unit: quantile-normalized Illumina intensity with negative background-adjusted values

GSE10588.reason: Independent severe-PE placental cohort. Individual gestational ages and most clinical covariates are unavailable, so cohort-specific estimates require sensitivity interpretation.

GSE24129.reason: Use PE and normotensive groups only; exclude eight isolated-FGR samples from the PE contrast while preserving them in the freeze and exclusion log.

GSE25906.reason: Independent placental cohort with recoverable gestational age, fetal sex, labor-induction and batch labels.

GSE43942.reason: Independent caesarean placental cohort; sample-level gestational age is unavailable.
GSE43942.expression_unit: RMA/quantile-normalized NimbleGen intensity on linear-looking scale

GSE4707.reason: EOPE/LOPE two-color placental arrays use a pooled three-normal-placenta common reference; useful for subtype direction checks, not core stable-gene discovery.

GSE44711.reason: EOPE chorionic-villus cohort with strong case-control gestational-age separation; subtype validation only.

GSE190639.reason: NanoString immune panel is targeted, not genome-wide; retain for EOPE/LOPE validation only.

GSE272342.reason: Independent unit is pregnancy (29), not placenta library (45). All controls are twin pregnancies while cases include singleton and twin pregnancies; never claim general PE replication.
GSE272342.expression_unit: raw HTSeq counts per placenta library
